# Surprise-MFs Tech

> Surprise-MFs Tech (surprisemfstech.com) is a high-performance digital engineering, web & mobile app development, and UI/UX design studio.

## Overview
- **Name**: Surprise-MFs Tech
- **Official Website**: https://surprisemfstech.com

## Core Services & Specializations
- **UI/UX Design**: Bespoke design systems, interactive Figma prototypes, user journeys, conversion rate optimization.
- **Custom Web Applications**: High-performance full-stack web applications, scalable database architectures, API integrations (React, Next.js, Laravel, Node.js).
- **Mobile App Development**: Native and cross-platform mobile apps for iOS and Android with smooth 60fps micro-interactions and offline sync.
- **E-Commerce Solutions**: Fast checkout workflows, inventory management, payment gateway integration (Stripe, Paystack, Flutterwave).
- **Digital Advertising & Growth**: High-converting Google Search/Display, Meta (Facebook/Instagram), and TikTok ad campaigns with retargeting.
- **SEO & Performance Optimization**: Core Web Vitals optimization, technical search engine optimization, and generative AI search indexing.
- **Brand Strategy & Visual Identity**: Memorable logos, visual styleguides, and digital brand presence.

## Pricing & Engagement Models
- **Project Build (Fixed Scope)**: Custom tailored quotation based on project timeline and requirements.
- **Tech Partner (Monthly Retainer)**: Dedicated on-demand engineering, continuous updates, and maintenance.
- **Budget-First Build**: Flexible roadmap engineering to deliver high-impact MVPs tailored to the client's available budget.
